rationale: The original thesis is intact: price still holds ~0.8% above session VWAP ($33.50), the 33.66 invalidation has not been threatened (MAE only -0.22%), and the risk-off tape (SPY -0.76%, VIXY +2.72%) continues to favor a relative-strength name. Post-entry pullback volume is lighter than the initial push (16k on the 33.82 lift vs ~4-10k on the drift), suggesting orderly consolidation rather than distribution. The stop risk (~$26) remains trivially small against the $549 remaining loss budget, and only 9 minutes have elapsed — far too soon to abandon a 2:1 setup; flipping short would fight the very divergence that justified the entry.
